pick.headline: Galtieri ousted after the Falklands defeat

evidence.title: FBIS Daily Report: Latin America, Vol. VI No. 117, 17 June 1982
evidence.snippet: …is post, the chief of his advisers reported tonight. The reasons for his resignation are not disagreement but a feeling of contribution and unselfishness, the official stated. It was not known whether President Leopoldo Galtieri had accepted it.
